notes: Curtin course pages state the academic entry text, an IELTS table and Curtin Perth application dates, but no per-program TOEFL/PTE and no China-specific mark requirement. No Curtin page with country-specific academic requirements for China was found (the international applying pages and the country-representative page list none), so china_page is omitted. The six remaining URLs are linked from Curtin study-area pages but returned HTTP 404 when snapshotted (also with --render); they were not retried through other hosts. Several CRICOS fixture courses (e.g. Master of Marketing, Finance, Human Resources, International Business, Computing, Supply Chain Management, Global Engagement, Pharmacy, Accounting 0101368/107620E) have no current Curtin course page in the study-area listings and are unmatched; Master of Accounting (mc-accntg) redirects to Master of Professional Accounting. Deadlines are the earliest upcoming Curtin Perth (or Perth City) close date on the page; the page does not say whether the dates apply to international applicants. Master of Arts (Applied Linguistics) and Teaching report no academic text because their entry rules are multi-way alternatives per specialisation. Pages without an IELTS table (Actuarial Science, Teaching) report none. cricos_code for Master of Advanced Practice and Master of Occupational Health and Safety comes from an exact unique name match in the CRICOS fixture because the page does not print it; Allied Health Practice and Information Science (Extended) have no CRICOS match.

academic.text: Prospective applicants to Curtin’s Master of Dietetics need an undergraduate degree that meets Dietitians Australia’s requirements. Dietitians Australia requires that human sciences underpin the application of science in nutrition and dietetic practice. To meet these criteria, 50% of the first year of undergraduate study must be composed of introductory bioscience (examples include chemistry, biology, introductory physiology). Prospective applicants also need to have completed two units of biochemistry, two units of human physiology, and four units of nutrition at second- and third-year level. Eligible applicants must also submit a personal statement. External applicants must arrange for two academic referee reports to be submitted to the Course Coordinator.

academic.text: Applicants require a recognised bachelor degree (or equivalent) in the field of taxation or a related discipline, or a Graduate Certificate or Graduate Diploma in the field of taxation or a related discipline. In addition, applicants must meet Curtin's English language proficiency requirements. Applicants without a related (cognate) Bachelor's degree will need to complete the Graduate Certificate in Taxation Practice to proceed to be considered for the Master of Taxation degree program.
